subtitle: International Day - Boarding Pass Guide
step1_desc: Visit the Administration booth to receive your unique boarding pass.
step2_desc: Visit different country booths, participate in activities, and collect stamps! You need at least 4 stamps to enter the main event.
step3_desc: Return to the Admin booth with 4+ stamps to join the 'Gacha' draw! Prizes include Galaxy Watch, Stanley Tumblers, and more. Don't forget to vote for the best booth with your sticker!
sns_desc:
1. Take a photo at the Photo Zone with your pass.
2. Post to Instagram Story and tag @i_friend_pknu.
3. Show staff to enter the lucky draw for a Vintage Digital Camera!
location: Location: In front of Baekgyeong Square
prizes: Main Prizes: Galaxy Watch, Stanley Tumbler, Power Bank, Brooch, etc.
